cause.title: Checkout total ignores the discount code after the shipping step
cause.description:
Opened by a bug signal from sdk:shop-web.

A shopper who applies a discount code on the cart page and then changes the shipping method is charged the full price. The cart shows the discounted total; the payment step charges the undiscounted one.

signals.title: Charged 84.00, cart said 71.40 with SPRING15
signals.subject: ticket 4471
signals.detail_md: Customer applied SPRING15, switched to express shipping, paid 84.00. Screenshot of the cart shows 71.40 + shipping.

signals.title: Discount vanished at payment
signals.subject: ticket 4462
signals.detail_md: Second report this week: the code is accepted, then the total at payment is the full price.

signals.title: Order total mismatch between cart and payment intent
signals.subject: eg-88
signals.detail_md: payment_intent.amount (8400) != cart.total (7140) after shipping_method change. Seen 9 times in 3 days.

comments.author: Dana
comments.text: Reproduced on staging: apply a code, change shipping, the payment step recomputes from the undiscounted subtotal.
